{{Top}}
'''Goat''' was a variety of mammalian herbivores found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Yondalla]] once described the [[Murra/Legends|murra]] as being "goat-like."<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

==Known species==
[[File:Hoaarr.jpg|thumb|200px|The Hoaarrs]]
*[[Unidentified Endorian goat creature|Endorian goat]] of [[Endor/Legends|the Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>
*[[Choreamnos]], another species found on Endor.<ref name="Creatures of Endor">{{SWArchive|url=kids/explore/eu/f20041123|text="Creatures of Endor"}}</ref>
*[[Mesa groat]] of [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref>
*[[Cophrigin horned goat]] of [[Cophrigin V]].<ref>"[[Extinction]]" — [[Star Wars Tales 1|''Star Wars Tales'' 1]]</ref>

==Uses of goat in names==
*[[Silvergrass|Goatgrass]], a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] delicacy.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
